input.summary: Insert reciprocal Array transition-assistance, continued-supply and return-of-Ono-data obligations in Section 14.2(a)
input.comment: [Playbook] Article XIV only runs one way: we transfer studies, Regulatory Filings, Data, trademarks and materials to Array, but Array has no obligation to support the transition, to keep supplying Materials while we are required to keep distributing during the Wind-down Period, or to return or destroy our Confidential Information and Data. We have added a reciprocal exit clause (transition assistance for up to six months at Array's then-current rates, return of our data within thirty days and certified destruction thereafter), preserving Array's retained rights under Sections 14.2(a)(iii), (v) and (ix); we can discuss a 90-day assistance period as a fallback.

ops.text: (x) Array Transition Obligations. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Array shall, at Ono's request: (A) continue to supply, or secure supply of, Materials in accordance with Article IX for so long as Ono is required to distribute the Product pursuant to Section 14.2(a)(ii), and provide reasonable transition assistance to Ono for a period of up to six (6) months following the effective date of termination at Array's then-current rates; (B) within thirty (30) days after the later of the effective date of termination and the end of the Wind-down Period, return to Ono all Confidential Information of Ono, and all Data and other materials provided by Ono, in each case in a commonly used, machine-readable format to the extent held in electronic form; and (C) thereafter delete or destroy any remaining copies thereof in its possession and certify such deletion or destruction in writing, in each case subject to Array's rights under Sections 14.2(a)(iii), (v) and (ix) and Array's right to retain one (1) copy for archiving purposes.
